shots.title: ONE CONNECTED BEAM
shots.caption: Beam + posts + soil
shots.narration: The corrugated steel beam connects to posts along the road.

shots.title: THE BEAM BENDS
shots.caption: The beam absorbs energy
shots.narration: When a car strikes, the beam bends, absorbing some of its energy.

shots.title: POSTS SHARE THE LOAD
shots.caption: Connections transfer forces
shots.narration: The posts rotate in the soil as the connections carry the load.

shots.title: REDIRECTING THE CAR
shots.caption: Along the road
shots.narration: Together, they help redirect the car along the road.

shots.title: IT HAS LIMITS
shots.caption: Vehicle + speed + impact angle
shots.narration: But protection has limits. The vehicle, speed, and impact angle all matter.
